sql_log.purpose: Compare the frozen object/edge inventory with the post-cut current catalog without treating current data as P0.
sql_log.sql:
with hist as (
  select
    x->>'caller' as caller,
    split_part(x->>'caller','.',1) as nspname,
    split_part(x->>'caller','.',2) as proname,
    (x->>'caller_oid')::oid as historical_oid,
    x->>'definition_md5' as historical_md5,
    x->'callees' as callees
  from public.lf_eventos e
  cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(e.payload->'sql_callers') x
  where e.id=20161
), resolved as (
  select h.*, p.oid as current_oid, md5(p.prosrc) as current_prosrc_md5,
         p.prosrc as current_body,
         count(p.oid) over (partition by h.caller) as overloads
  from hist h
  left join pg_namespace n on n.nspname=h.nspname
  left join pg_proc p on p.pronamespace=n.oid and p.proname=h.proname
), per_caller as (
  select caller,historical_oid,historical_md5,callees,
         count(current_oid) as current_matches,
         bool_or(current_oid=historical_oid) as same_oid,
         bool_or(current_prosrc_md5=historical_md5) as any_prosrc_hash_match,
         max(current_body) filter (where current_oid=historical_oid) as selected_body
  from resolved
  group by caller,historical_oid,historical_md5,callees
), edges as (
  select p.caller,
         c.value #>> '{}' as callee,
         case when p.selected_body is null then null
              else position(lower(c.value #>> '{}') in lower(p.selected_body))>0 end as current_text_present
  from per_caller p
  cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(p.callees) c
)
select
  (select count(*) from per_caller) as historical_callers,
  (select count(*) from per_caller where current_matches=0) as absent_callers,
  (select count(*) from per_caller where current_matches>1) as overloaded_callers,
  (select count(*) from per_caller where same_oid) as same_oid_callers,
  (select count(*) from per_caller where any_prosrc_hash_match) as prosrc_hash_matches,
  (select count(*) from per_caller where not any_prosrc_hash_match and current_matches>0) as prosrc_hash_mismatches,
  (select count(*) from edges) as declared_edges,
  (select count(*) from edges where current_text_present) as edges_text_present,
  (select count(*) from edges where current_text_present is false) as edges_text_absent,
  (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('caller',caller,'callee',callee) order by caller,callee)
     from edges where current_text_present is false) as absent_edge_pairs
